bug.trigger: Voice-package removal deactivates index then shutil.rmtree raises, including partial Windows file deletion.
bug.before: Files remain, admin list becomes empty; no accessible retry removal or version selection.

design: Before deleting any registered voice assets, atomically move ID/version from active to inactive ownership. Speech discovery continues to read active only.
Retain inactive ownership across deletion exceptions, abrupt process exit, keep_files=True and final index-write failures; retry cleanup is idempotent even with no files left.

Only registered IDs can be deleted. Administrative listing includes registered inactive rows without directory enumeration. Explicit Ukrainian inactive label; removal and existing verified version activation remain accessible. The installed-version chooser includes the sole retained version for an inactive entry; active entries still exclude their current version.

Index writer emits format2 only while nonempty inactive ownership exists. New reader accepts legacy format1 without inactive and format2 with an inactive map, validates IDs/versions/exclusions and rejects overlap/unsupported/malformed versions. Old v1 readers reject format2 rather than silently corrupting ownership.
Successful verified install/activation clears inactive ownership. Successful full cleanup normalizes back to active-only format1.

Core migration preserves inactive ownership, rejects active/inactive/version collisions, never alters old data. Partly damaged retained data blocks upgrade until explicit cleanup, preserving its administrative retry entry.
